tool_name = f"QA_Automation_Tool_{unique_id}" with allure.step("Navigate to Tools and start building a new tool"): tool_page = ToolPage(driver) tool_page.click_tools_nav() tool_page.click_generate() tool_page.enter_tool_name(tool_name) tool_page.enter_tool_description( "A simple tool that reverses the input text string, used for QA automation testing." ) tool_page.click_generate_code() attach_step_screenshot(driver, "Code generation started") tool_page.wait_for_code_generation() attach_step_screenshot(driver, "Code generated") with allure.step("Click 'Create Tool' and wait for it to
